clips.title: The story
paras: Zamek can create the diversion that Keeping Pace calls for. It comes while you are in the middle of that step, and Keeping Pace cannot be finished without it.
While you are working through Keeping Pace, Zamek can create a diversion. When it happens, Rizzle leaves his hut, and the Indurium plans are left behind.
